## Problem

Describe what happened and what you expected.

## Reproduction

Give the steps using synthetic values where possible. Include the selected platform and mode.

## Environment

- OnlyGoblins version
- Operating system
- Windows ZIP or Python installation
- Error code or sanitized message

## Privacy check

- [ ] I excluded cookies, tokens, account IDs, browser exports and config files.
- [ ] Any logs or screenshots are sanitized and exclude private creator or media information.
- [ ] I checked existing issues at https://github.com/ZenoBell/FanGoblin/issues.
